steps.name: Precondition cleanup — idempotent best-effort delete of any stale 'my-artifact-toolkit' toolkit / 'new-bucket' bucket (this case's own literal Test Data — see AFS § Test Data)
Step 1 — Navigate to the Toolkits section
Step 2 — Verify the Toolkits list page is displayed (may be empty or show existing toolkits)

Steps 3-4 — Click '+ Toolkit'; verify the 'New Toolkit' wizard opens (URL-based — the 'Choose the toolkit type' heading carries no testid, and the URL already satisfies this step's own observable per the AFS)
Step 5 — Verify the type-picker's search field is present with placeholder 'Search toolkits'
Step 6 — Verify the category filter tabs are displayed (12 confirmed live)
Step 7 — Type 'art' in the search field
Steps 8-9 — Verify the toolkit list filters to show the 'Artifact' card and to exclude non-matching types (the case's own text splits one observable across two steps)
Step 10 — Click the 'Artifact' toolkit card (via its testid, never text-matching — a text-based locator resolves to a non-interactive ancestor and silently no-ops); verify the config form opens
Step 11 — Verify the CONFIGURATION section's Name and Bucket fields are present
Step 12 — Verify the TOOLS section shows all 16 tools, EVERY ONE checkmarked (data-selected='true' on all 16, not just a count — Axis 2 addition, folds in the case's own 'with checkmarks' observable)
Step 13 — Verify the 'Make tools available by MCP' checkbox is present and unchecked by default
Step 14 — Verify Save (disabled pre-dirty) and Cancel (enabled) are both present
Step 15 — Hover (NOT click) the info icon next to the Bucket field — KNOWN CLARIFICATION #669: case text says 'click', live product only wires hover/focus
Step 16 — Verify the tooltip shows the exact bucket naming-rules text
Step 17 — Enter 'my-artifact-toolkit' into the Toolkit Name field
Step 18 — Enter 'new-bucket' into the Bucket field
Step 19 — Leave all other fields at their defaults — verify the MCP checkbox is still unchecked (unchanged by filling Name/Bucket)
Side-channel check — no console errors across the type-picker + config-form flow so far (steps 1-19)
Steps 20-21 — Click Save; verify navigation to the toolkit-detail view and capture the new toolkit's numeric ID (needed for teardown)
Step 22 — Verify the detail page header shows the toolkit name
Step 23 — Verify the URL updates to reflect the new toolkit (numeric ID + '?name=' query param)

Axis 2 — Verify the create call's network shape: exactly ONE POST to the toolkit-create endpoint (201), and NO separate POST to any bucket-create endpoint — proves the bucket is a server-side side effect of the SAME create call, per the case's own objective text
Step 24 — Verify the Configuration surface and the Indexes surface are both shown on the detail view
Step 24b — Open the Test Toolkit surface via the detail view's action-bar 'Test' button
Step 25 — Verify the Test Toolkit view shows the tool selection entry point (empty state)
Step 26 — Click the Tool dropdown
Step 27 — Verify the tool list shows all tools including 'List files'
Step 28 — Select 'List files' from the Tool dropdown
Step 28b — Verify model information appears after tool selection
Step 29 — Verify the 'List files' parameter panel shows Bucket Name, Folder, Recursive, Include, Skip, and the 'Run Test' button
Step 30 — Click 'Run Test', leaving all parameter fields at their default (empty) values, per the case's own literal step sequence
Step 31 — Verify the tool runs and returns a result in the center panel — an empty result is the CORRECT outcome for a just-created, never-uploaded-to bucket
